en.name: Masa harina
en.summary: Masa harina keeps 6–12 months from purchase in a cool dry cupboard, and about 12 months refrigerated once opened. Both figures are read across from degerminated cornmeal, which is the closest published match — no agency publishes one for masa harina.
en.pantry: 6–12 months from purchase, cool, dry and dark, in the sealed bag inside an airtight tin. Masa harina is dried, ground nixtamalised corn, and it still carries some corn germ oil, so the way it ends is stale-rancid rather than mouldy: a crayon or cardboard smell means it is past its useful life, however far off the printed date is. Keep it away from the hob and the kettle, and seal it properly — an open paper bag is an open invitation to pantry moths, which are the commonest way a bag of corn flour is actually lost.
en.fridge: About 12 months refrigerated after opening, in a sealed container at 4 °C (40 °F) or below. Refrigerating an opened bag roughly doubles its useful life and keeps pantry moths out entirely, which is worth the shelf space if you use masa occasionally rather than weekly. Let it come back to room temperature before mixing, so it does not pull condensation out of the air — masa harina is thirsty and takes up ambient moisture readily, which is exactly what makes it clump.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for masa harina. Freezing a sealed, airtight container is a reasonable thing to do with a large bag, and it protects the germ oil the same way refrigeration does, but repeated trips in and out cause condensation and caking. If you freeze it, freeze it in one sealed portion and let it warm fully in the sealed container before opening.
en.thawing: Let a chilled or frozen container come back to room temperature before opening, so the flour does not take up condensation. Cold masa harina also absorbs water unevenly when you mix the dough.
spoilage: A crayon, cardboard or paint-like smell — the germ oil has gone stale.
Hard clumps that will not break up, which means moisture got in.
Webbing, larvae or small moths in the bag, in which case the whole bag goes out.
Dough that tastes flat and refuses to hold together when pressed.
tips: Decant into an airtight tin; the paper bag protects nothing.
Refrigerate an opened bag if you use masa only occasionally.
Let it warm to room temperature before mixing.
Fresh masa is a different, perishable product and keeps only days — do not confuse the two.

faq.q: How long does masa harina last?
faq.a: 6–12 months from purchase in a cool dry cupboard, or about 12 months refrigerated once opened. Both figures are read across from degerminated cornmeal.
An opened bag benefits — it roughly doubles the useful life and keeps pantry moths out. Let it come back to room temperature before mixing.

faq.q: How can you tell if masa harina is past it?
faq.a: Smell it. A crayon or cardboard note means the corn germ oil has gone stale, and the tortillas will taste of nothing.

zh.name: 鹼處理玉米粉
zh.summary: masa harina 自購買日起放陰涼乾燥處可放 6～12 個月；拆封後冷藏約 12 個月。這兩個數字都是比照去胚玉米粉讀過來的，那是資料裡最接近的對照——沒有機關為 masa harina 公布期限。
zh.pantry: 自購買日起 6～12 個月，陰涼、乾燥、避光，連原袋一起收進密封罐。masa harina 是乾燥磨碎的鹼處理玉米，裡面仍帶著一些玉米胚芽油，所以它的結局是「走味油耗」而不是長霉：聞到蠟筆味或紙板味，就表示它的有用壽命結束了，不管印製日期還有多久。請遠離爐火和熱水壺，並且確實密封——一個敞著的紙袋等於在邀請穀蛾，而那才是一袋玉米粉最常見的真正死因。
zh.fridge: 拆封後裝密封罐放 4 °C 以下，約 12 個月。把拆封的袋子冰起來，大約能把有用壽命翻一倍，而且完全杜絕穀蛾；如果你只是偶爾做玉米餅而不是每週都做，那個冰箱位置很值得。調麵團前先讓它回到室溫，才不會從空氣中吸水——masa harina 很「渴」，吸環境濕氣吸得很快，而那正是它結塊的原因。
zh.freezer: masa harina 沒有公布的冷凍期限。把整個密封罐冷凍對大包裝是合理的做法，保護胚芽油的效果和冷藏一樣；但反覆進出會結露、結塊。真要冷凍就一次密封一份，開蓋前務必讓它在密封狀態下完全回溫。
zh.thawing: 冰過或冷凍過的容器要回到室溫再開蓋，粉才不會受潮。而且冰冷的 masa harina 在調麵團時吸水也會不均勻。
spoilage: 聞起來有蠟筆味、紙板味或油漆味——胚芽油走味了。
結成壓不散的硬塊，表示受潮。
袋子裡出現絲網、幼蟲或小蛾，整袋丟掉。
調出來的麵團味道扁平，壓餅時黏不起來。
tips: 倒進密封罐；紙袋什麼也擋不住。
如果只是偶爾用，拆封後就放冷藏。
調麵團前先讓粉回到室溫。
新鮮 masa 麵團是另一種易腐產品，只能放幾天，別搞混。

faq.a: 自購買日起放陰涼乾燥處 6～12 個月；拆封後冷藏約 12 個月。兩個數字都是比照去胚玉米粉而來。
拆封後冷藏有幫助——大約能把壽命翻一倍，也能杜絕穀蛾。調麵團前先讓它回到室溫。

faq.q: 怎麼判斷 masa harina 過頭了？
faq.a: 聞一下。有蠟筆味或紙板味就是玉米胚芽油走味了，做出來的餅會沒有味道。
